claims.sourceText: National Security Archive catalogue record for the 5 April 1950 Project Bluebird memorandum, https://nsarchive.gwu.edu/document/32717-document-02-chief-inspection-and-security-staff-us-central-intelligence-agency
claims.text: The Director on that date was Hillenkoetter. The memorandum itself names only the office; the National Security Archive's catalogue record for it names him as the recipient, and this node already dates his tenure as DCI from May 1947 to October 1950 on a CIA-held clipping. The identification is Tier 2 because the document does not make it.

edges.label: Submitted directly to the DCI, 5 April 1950
edges.note: The memorandum is addressed to the Director of Central Intelligence and asks him for approval and allocation of funds outside the Projects Review Committee; Hillenkoetter held that office from May 1947 to October 1950, and the National Security Archive's catalogue record names him as the recipient.

title: National Security Archive catalogue record for the 5 April 1950 Project Bluebird memorandum
